items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Amasty patches 25 Magento extensions, 1 critical
items.summary: Amasty issued a security release for 25 extensions, including one critical vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce enables remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized write access.

items.title: Adobe Commerce DOS Vulnerability
items.summary: A denial-of-service vulnerability in Adobe Commerce, caused by a vulnerable third-party component, allows unauthenticated remote attackers to crash instances and disrupt availability.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique, with mass attacks observed in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.
